TERMS AND CONDITIONS
FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO – AERIAL SPORTS CLUB

Language and prevailing version
This document is provided in English as an informational translation of the Terms and Conditions originally drafted in Spanish. In the event of any discrepancy, difference in interpretation, or conflict between both versions, the Spanish version shall prevail.

FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO is a sports project of Fundación Fraterno, focused on the practice of aerial sports and the development of formative and recreational sports experiences.

Skydiving activities and, in general, the aerial sports currently offered or that may be offered in the future by FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO, such as paragliding, paramotoring, or other related activities, constitute high-risk sports activities, carried out within the framework of voluntary, formative, and recreational practice, and are regulated by the competent authorities in Colombia, including Aeronáutica Civil, Inder, and FEDEAEREOS.

Participation in any of these activities is carried out as a student of a sports club and does not constitute the provision of tourism services or commercial air transportation, but rather the practice of sports activities under the technical, operational, and safety standards applicable to aerial sports.

Participation in the activities offered by FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO requires the prior, express, free, and informed acceptance of these Terms and Conditions, which govern access, use, contracting, payments, reservations, changes, cancellations, refunds, health conditions, requirements, documentation, and all other aspects related to the sports practice.

Operational Nature of the Activity
The aerial activities carried out by FRATERNO SKYDIVING depend on multiple operational, technical, meteorological, and safety factors that may affect the scheduling, duration, or execution of the activity.
Consequently, the student acknowledges and accepts that operational safety will always take priority over any individual expectation, and therefore instructors, pilots, and authorized personnel may make the operational decisions necessary to ensure the safety of the activity.

1. PURPOSE AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE TERMS
This document aims to regulate the conditions under which students participate in the aerial sports activities offered by FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO, including operational, administrative, technical, and safety aspects.
Acceptance of these Terms and Conditions is mandatory and constitutes an essential requirement for participation. In the event of disagreement with their content, the interested party must refrain from making a reservation and from participating in the activity.

8. CHANGES, CANCELLATIONS, AND REFUNDS
8.1 Reservation changes
All change requests must be submitted exclusively through the official WhatsApp number +57 302 338 1129, using the same phone number registered at the time of purchase.
Changes shall be subject to the following deadlines and conditions:
- Changes requested at least ten (10) calendar days in advance: An additional fee of COP $220,000 per student shall apply.
- Changes requested between eight (8) and ten (10) calendar days prior to the scheduled date: An additional fee of COP $960,000 per student shall apply.
- Changes requested less than three (3) calendar days in advance: Such changes will not be accepted, and the reservation shall be deemed a withdrawal from the service, with no right to refund.

8.2 Cancellations and no-shows by the student
If the student decides not to carry out the activity on the scheduled date, no refund shall apply. Failure to attend, no-show without prior notice, or delays that prevent the execution of the activity shall be considered a withdrawal from the service, resulting in the loss of the full amount paid for the reserved slot.

8.3 Cancellations by FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO
In cases of adverse weather conditions, airspace restrictions, temporary technical failures, inspections, public order issues, or other situations of force majeure or unforeseeable events that prevent the activity from taking place, the activity shall be rescheduled for a new available date, without implying an automatic refund.

9. NO-SHOWS, DELAYS, AND EXTERNAL VARIABLES
The student acknowledges that aerial activities depend on multiple factors beyond the Club’s control, including but not limited to: Weather conditions, Restrictions imposed by aeronautical authorities, Airport operations.

10. SCHEDULES, CONFIRMATION, AND RESCHEDULING
The exact time of the activity shall be confirmed on the day prior to the scheduled date. The student acknowledges and accepts that, due to the nature of aerial activities, it is not possible to guarantee a fixed time further in advance.

13. EXCLUSION AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO shall be liable only within the applicable legal framework and in accordance with the standards required for the practice of aerial sports in Colombia. Accordingly, FRATERNO PARACAIDISMO shall not be liable for: Delays, no-shows, or cancellations attributable to the student. Loss, damage, or misplacement of the student’s personal belongings. Damages or injuries arising from the inherent risks associated with the practice of aerial sports.

FINAL DECLARATION OF THE STUDENT
By making the reservation payment and/or participating in the activity, the student declares that they have read, understood, and fully accepted these Terms and Conditions, acknowledge the high-risk nature of the activity, and accept the inherent risks associated with the practice of aerial sports, within the applicable legal framework, without implying any waiver of non-waivable rights under Colombian law, nor of applicable insurance coverage.

DECLARATION OF LIABILITY WAIVER
AND INFORMED ASSUMPTION OF RISKS

I, of legal age, acting on my own behalf and in a free, voluntary, and informed manner, declare that I wish to participate in aerial sports activities organized by CLUB DEPORTIVO FUNDACIÓN FRATERNO, including but not limited to sport skydiving and flight experiences such as “Pilot for a day”, identified with NIT 901.334.881-4, hereinafter THE CLUB.

FIRST – NATURE OF THE ACTIVITY (HIGH RISK)
I declare that I know, understand, and accept that the aerial sports activities organized by THE CLUB, including but not limited to sport skydiving and flight experiences such as “Pilot for a day”, are high-risk activities involving inherent factors such as falls, impacts, human errors, weather conditions, aircraft operation, aerial maneuvers, use of specialized equipment, and uncontrollable external variables, which can cause serious injuries, permanent disability, or even death, even when safety protocols, technical standards, and preventive measures are applied.

SECOND – INFORMED ASSUMPTION OF RISK
I declare that I consciously, expressly, and voluntarily assume all inherent, foreseeable, and unforeseeable risks derived from my participation in the activity, even those that may occur even when THE CLUB, its instructors, operational staff, or collaborators act diligently and in accordance with applicable technical and regulatory standards.

THIRD – LIABILITY WAIVER
Consequently, I exonerate, release, and hold harmless THE CLUB, as well as its directors, executive committee, instructors, coaches, skydivers, operational staff, packers, event organizers, contractors, strategic allies, owners of aircraft and properties where the activity takes place, airport operators, and other third parties directly or indirectly linked to the operation, including but not limited to the Colombian Federation of Aerial Sports – FEDEAEREOS, the Institute of Sports and Recreation – INDER, the Civil Aeronautics of Colombia, and other civil, sports, aeronautical, or administrative authorities of a local or national nature, from any claim, lawsuit, or civil or extra-contractual liability action derived exclusively from the inherent risks of practicing sport skydiving.
This waiver does not cover events derived from willful misconduct or gross negligence, in accordance with the law.

NINTH – ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS
I declare that I have fully read, understood, and accepted this document, as well as THE CLUB's Terms and Conditions, which have been made available to me through various means.

In witness whereof, I sign this document as a sign of free, voluntary, and informed acceptance.
